description: Health of Trickster's tcp, tls and udp stream listeners: connection verdicts, relayed bytes, udp datagram drops, and the ALB pool members they dial.

panels.title: Active connections
panels.description: tcp/tls connections and udp sessions open on the selected stream listeners right now. The count starts at accept (udp: at a new client's first datagram), so it includes connections still in IP/geo/rate-limit admission, waiting for a TLS ClientHello or dialing the upstream, and failed udp flows held for 5 s. No metric exposes connections_limit: a tcp/tls listener at its limit stops accepting (new clients wait in the kernel backlog) and counts nothing, so compare this with the configured limit. 'not configured' means no tcp, tls or udp listener exists.

targets.expr: sum(trickster_proxy_stream_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"})

panels.title: New connections/s
panels.description: tcp/tls connections and udp sessions per second that reached a verdict on the selected listeners, every result included (proxied, refused, denied, dial_failed, ...). proxied is counted when relaying starts, so this is a connection-setup rate, not completed traffic. On udp a client turned away at the session bound adds one refused per datagram, so one chatty client can inflate this. 'not configured' means no tcp, tls or udp listener exists.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum(trickster_proxy_stream_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}))

panels.title: Not proxied
panels.description: Share of new connections and udp sessions that were not relayed: every result other than proxied (not_tls, no_route, no_upstream, dial_failed, refused, denied). Healthy is near 0; orange from 1 %, red from 5 %; reads 0 while no new connections arrive. denied is policy (IP/geo ACL or rate limit) rather than a fault, and udp refused counts per datagram, which can push this toward 100 % while one client is over the session bound. The Connections row shows the mix.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", result!="proxied"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) or (0 * sum(trickster_proxy_stream_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"})) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second relayed by the selected stream listeners, client-to-upstream plus upstream-to-client. For tcp and tls a connection's bytes are added only when it closes, so long-lived tunnels (database pools, websockets) read as 0 until they end and then arrive as one spike, and the bytes of connections open at a crash or restart are never counted. Do not alert on low tcp throughput. udp is counted per datagram; mirror copies and dropped datagrams are excluded. 'not configured' means no tcp, tls or udp listener exists.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_proxy_stream_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Dial failures
panels.description: For stream listeners mapped to an alb backend: failed dials as a share of all pool member results (dial_failed / (dial_failed + proxied + unreachable)) for the selected members. Every failed attempt counts, retries included, while proxied is counted when a member connection ends, so the ratio rises ahead of the proxied count in an outage. Orange from 1 %, red from 5 %; 'no members' means no stream listener has picked an ALB pool member yet. The header link opens pool health.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend", result="dial_failed"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) or (0 * sum(rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) or vector(-1)

panels.title: UDP drops/s
panels.description: Datagrams per second the selected udp listeners dropped: queue_full (a session's queue, the shared queued-byte budget or the allowance of sessions still opening was full), write_timeout (a write to the upstream blocked for 1 s) or denied (per-datagram admission refused it). Any sustained value means clients are losing datagrams; orange above 0, red from 10/s. Clients refused at the session bound are counted as refused connections instead. Reads 0 without a udp listener.

targets.expr: sum(rate(trickster_proxy_stream_dropped_datagrams_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Connections/s by result
panels.description: New tcp/tls connections and udp sessions per second on the selected listeners, stacked by result: proxied (dialed and relaying); not_tls (no parseable ClientHello on a tls listener); no_route (no backend for the SNI and no catch-all); no_upstream (the ALB had no dialable member, or the picked member refuses its share through a .invalid origin); dial_failed (every dial and retry failed within stream.connect_timeout); refused (tcp/tls: closed by shutdown between dial and relay; udp: listener draining or at its session bound, counted per datagram); denied (an IP ACL, geo ACL or rate limit refused it, or a udp flow expired without an allowed datagram). Each result series appears on its first occurrence; the header link opens the access dashboard for denials.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Not-proxied share by listener
panels.description: Per listener, the share of new connections or udp sessions that were not relayed (every result other than proxied), with dashed lines at 1 % and 5 %. Gaps mean the listener had no new connections in the interval. A tls listener with a high share usually gets clients with an unknown SNI (no_route) or non-TLS bytes (not_tls); a udp listener near 100 % usually has one client over the session bound, since refused counts per datagram.

targets.expr: (sum by (listener_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", result!="proxied"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (listener_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (sum by (listener_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Active connections by listener
panels.description: Open tcp/tls connections and udp sessions per listener. Counted from accept or flow admission, so it includes connections still in admission, TLS peek or dial, and failed udp flows held for 5 s. A tcp/tls line flat at the listener's connections_limit means new clients are queuing in the kernel backlog, which no counter records; a udp listener without a limit holds at most 1024 sessions. A removed listener keeps its last value until restart.

targets.expr: sum by (listener_name, protocol) (trickster_proxy_stream_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"})

panels.title: Not-proxied connections/s by listener and result
panels.description: The verdicts behind the not-proxied share, per listener and result (proxied left out). Use it to tell policy denials (denied) from routing gaps (no_route, not_tls), capacity (refused) and upstream trouble (no_upstream, dial_failed). For a listener mapped to an ALB, the ALB pool members row shows which member failed to dial.

targets.expr: sum by (listener_name, result) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", result!="proxied"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Throughput by direction
panels.description: Bytes per second relayed by the selected listeners: in is client to upstream, out is upstream to client. tcp and tls add a connection's totals once, when it closes, so this graph is spiky and reads 0 for connections that stay open; a tls listener counts the TLS records it relays unterminated, ClientHello included. udp counts each datagram written (in: to the primary member only, mirror copies excluded; out: replies written to the client).

targets.expr: sum by (direction) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Throughput by listener
panels.description: Bytes per second relayed per listener, both directions together. tcp and tls bytes arrive in one step when each connection closes, so a flat line does not mean an idle listener; compare with active connections.

targets.expr: sum by (listener_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Listener summary (selected range)
panels.description: One row per stream listener over the dashboard's time range: connections open now, new connections and udp sessions, how many were not proxied and their share (orange from 1 %, red from 5 %), bytes in and out, and average bytes per proxied connection. The average is approximate for tcp/tls because a connection is counted when it starts and its bytes when it ends. udp refused counts per datagram, which inflates Connections and Not proxied while a client is over the session bound.

targets.expr: sum by (listener_name, protocol) (trickster_proxy_stream_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"})

sum by (listener_name, protocol) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (listener_name, protocol) (trickster_proxy_stream_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"})

sum by (listener_name, protocol) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", result!="proxied"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (listener_name, protocol) (trickster_proxy_stream_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"})

(sum by (listener_name, protocol) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", result!="proxied"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (listener_name, protocol) (trickster_proxy_stream_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"})) / (sum by (listener_name, protocol) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__range])) > 0)
sum by (listener_name, protocol) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", direction="in"}[$__range]))
sum by (listener_name, protocol) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", direction="out"}[$__range]))

sum by (listener_name, protocol) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_bytes_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__range])) / (sum by (listener_name, protocol) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", result="proxied"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Active connections per member
panels.description: Connections and udp sessions open to each ALB pool member behind the selected stream listeners, from a successful dial until the route closes; udp mirror copies count too. Use it to check balance across members. Only listeners mapped to an alb backend have member series. On udp the count rises when the socket is created, even if nothing listens on the member. Members removed by autodiscovery lose their series; static members removed by a reload keep a stale one.

targets.expr: sum by (backend_name) (trickster_proxy_stream_member_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"})

panels.title: Member connection results/s
panels.description: Pool member outcomes per second for the selected members, stacked. proxied is counted when the member's connection or session ends cleanly, so it lags by the connection's lifetime; dial_failed is counted for every failed dial attempt, alb.stream.connect_retries included; unreachable is a udp member that answered with an ICMP port-unreachable. Connect-race losers are not counted, and because of retries, mirrors and races the sum does not equal the listener's connection count.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Dial-failure ratio by member
panels.description: Per member (the 10 worst), dial_failed over all member results, with dashed lines at 1 % and 5 %. A member near 100 % is down or unreachable; with connect_retries at 0 (the default) its share of new connections is refused, not retried elsewhere, until a health check, autodiscovery or passive_health takes it out. Gaps mean the member had no results in the interval.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (backend_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend", result="dial_failed"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (backend_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (sum by (backend_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0))

panels.title: Mean connect time by member
panels.description: Average time of successful dials to each member (the 10 slowest; histogram sum / count, failed dials excluded). For tcp/tls it is the TCP connect, or the race winner's connect; for udp it is only name resolution plus socket creation, so udp values are near 0 and say little about the member. The mean is used because the histogram's smallest bucket is 50 ms, which holds every LAN connect, so quantiles would be interpolation artefacts.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (backend_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connect_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (backend_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connect_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0))

panels.title: Member connect time distribution
panels.description: Successful member dials per histogram bucket over time, all selected members together. The buckets are 50 ms, 100 ms, 500 ms, 1 s, 5 s, 10 s and 20 s, so a healthy LAN pool shows everything in the lowest (up to 50 ms) row; mass in the 1 s and higher rows points to a slow or overloaded member, slow name resolution or SYN retransmits. Pick one member in the Backend filter to inspect it alone.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connect_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Member summary (selected range)
panels.description: One row per stream listener and pool member over the dashboard's time range: connections open now, connections proxied (counted when they end), failed dials (each attempt), udp port-unreachable results, the dial-failure share (orange from 1 %, red from 5 %) and the mean successful connect time. Static pool members removed by a config reload keep stale rows until Trickster restarts.

targets.expr: sum by (listener_name, backend_name) (trickster_proxy_stream_member_active_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"})

sum by (listener_name, backend_name) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend", result="proxied"}[$__range]))

sum by (listener_name, backend_name) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend", result="dial_failed"}[$__range]))

sum by (listener_name, backend_name) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend", result="unreachable"}[$__range]))

sum by (listener_name, backend_name) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend", result="dial_failed"}[$__range])) / (sum by (listener_name, backend_name) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (listener_name, backend_name) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connect_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__range])) / (sum by (listener_name, backend_name) (increase(trickster_proxy_stream_member_connect_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", backend_name=~"$backend"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: UDP datagram drops/s by reason
panels.description: Datagrams per second dropped per udp listener and reason. queue_full: the session's 16-datagram queue, the 8 MiB queued-byte budget shared by all sessions, or the 4-datagram / 1 MiB allowance of sessions still opening was full. write_timeout: a write to the upstream blocked for the whole 1 s bound (a stalled member). denied: refused by per-datagram admission (rate limit), sent by a client held after a denial, or discarded while its flow waited for an allowed datagram. There is no total-datagram counter, so no drop ratio; datagrams of a failed flow during its 5 s hold are discarded uncounted.

targets.expr: sum by (listener_name, reason) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_dropped_datagrams_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: UDP refused datagrams/s
panels.description: Datagrams per second from new udp clients turned away because the listener was draining, at its session bound (connections_limit, or 1024 when unset) or at the bound on sessions still opening. This is the refused result of the connection counter, and it counts once per datagram, not once per client or session, because no session is created: one chatty client over the limit can add thousands per second. If it is sustained, raise connections_limit or find the client.

targets.expr: sum by (listener_name) (rate(trickster_proxy_stream_connections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", listener_name=~"$listener", protocol="udp", result="refused"}[$__rate_interval]))

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: The Prometheus-compatible data source that scrapes Trickster's /metrics endpoint.

list.name: job
list.label: Job
list.description: Scrape job(s) holding the Trickster targets.

list.name: listener
list.label: Listener
list.description: Stream listeners (listeners with protocol tcp, tls or udp). Every stream listener is listed as soon as it is configured.

list.name: backend
list.label: Backend
list.description: ALB pool members dialed by the selected stream listeners (the leaf member backends, not the ALB). Filters the ALB pool member panels only; listed after a member's first pick.
